name: disconnect_matrix
_comment: T153: client_1 quits through the pause menu (graceful ENet disconnect) and at tick 400 tries to rejoin through Title -> MPEntry -> Join while the match runs (expected: server kicks it on connect, back at the title, no RPC leak). bot_takeover: the server hands the leaver's live mech to the bot AI (T123; the script stands still, so movement = bot). peer_closed: quitter disconnected; refused rejoiner routed to the title (V40 exception).
